name: KOReader Sync
description: Sync book reading progress with KOReader devices. Provides an API endpoint compatible with KOReader Progress Sync functionality, allowing users to sync their book reading progress between KOReader devices and Jellyfin.
overview: Sync book reading progress with KOReader

versions.changelog: Version 2.0.4.1 - Fix plugin icon: build the DLL with assembly version equal to the plugin version. The v12.0.0 tag had leaked 12.0.0.0 into the assembly version, so Jellyfin requested /Plugins/<Id>/12.0.0.0/Image (404) and showed a blank tile. The release tag no longer influences the plugin version.
Version 2.0.4.1 - Update targetABI to 12.0.0.0 for Jellyfin 12.0

Version 2.0.3 - AI maintainer takeover! 🤖 Added full automated testing pipeline, end-to-end sync validation, Docker-based builds, and conflict resolution testing. Now maintained by your friendly neighborhood AI assistant with monthly automated maintenance checks.
Version 2.0.1 - make build release scripts generic for reuse in other projects
Version 2.0.0 - Cleanup files related to old CI and documentation
